title: SIRA's pre-registered evaluation on the test split
before: Every design choice was made on the dev split. No test-split object has been replayed through the lab, refitted or looked at before this plan was timestamped.
The forecast pool stays at 50% physics and 50% Muse's own forecast, fixed on 2026-10-27 before any dev result could tune it.

replay.rule: replay.pick(root, 'test', 10): the first 10 test objects with checkpoints in each of ia, cc, rare and microlensing, ordered by sha256 of the object id

runs.a: uv run sira replay --split test --per 10 --out evidence/test/a
runs.b: uv run sira replay --split test --per 10 --out evidence/test/b

replay.note: two independent runs of the same 40 cases, because Muse's answers vary between runs; nothing is rerun or dropped after the fact, and a case that fails is reported as failed

primary.metric: mean log score per scored measurement, SIRA minus rival, for rivals B2 (Muse alone) and B1 (physics alone)
primary.unit: each case's mean paired difference, averaged over runs a and b; the headline is the mean over cases
primary.interval: 95% bootstrap interval resampling whole cases, 10000 draws, numpy seed 0
primary.claim: 'SIRA forecasts better than X on unseen objects' only if the interval's lower end is above zero
primary.fallback: if SIRA does not beat B2 this way, the public message moves to calibration and accountability and no claim of beating Muse alone is made

secondary: share of cases where SIRA's mean paired difference is above zero, against B2 and B1
the same comparison for each run alone and for each category alone
CRPS, 90% interval coverage and class log loss for SIRA, B0, B1 and B2
ablations: without Muse's own forecast, without the team's reweighting, without Le Verrier's adopted model, and the forecast pool at 25% and 75%
bets the instrument skeptic dropped, surprises, Le Verrier verdicts and Muse spend

distance.what: F7: host redshift from an SN Ia light curve alone, median |dz|/z
distance.objects: test-split ia (and cc as the control that must fail)
distance.how: accept.at1 restricted to the test split: absolute magnitude calibrated on half the objects, predicted on the other half, 200 random halves, seed 0
distance.report: both every fit and the fits passing the quality cuts already in models.ia_distance (|x1|<3, |c|<0.3, sigma_x1<1.5, sigma_t0<2 d, MW E(B-V)<0.2, fit probability>0.001); the cuts are not changed

verdicts.what: Neptune or Vulcan: a lens and an SN Ia model fitted before the peak and judged on the future they never saw
verdicts.how: accept.at2 restricted to the test split
verdicts.report: accuracy on decisive verdicts and the abstention rate; plus, from the Le Verrier replays below at three proposals, the share of lens cases where Muse Wonder's proposal earned a Neptune verdict and the number of Neptune verdicts on SN Ia controls

live.what: SIRA's live record: of the yes/no questions the sky has answered, how many SIRA got right (more than 50% on what happened)
live.freeze: the ledger head anchored by the nightly run of 2026-11-03 (Chile); void questions are left out and reported
live.also: Brier score and log score of those answers

cost.what: Muse spend per investigated transient in the live nightly
cost.how: all event costs on nights the team ran (reader, lookouts, team, Le Verrier) divided by the objects that got a bet those nights, up to the freeze head

leverrier.how: leverrier.case with leaps ['hidden', 'new', 'instrument', 'hidden', 'new'] on every listed object, one run
leverrier.sizes: 1, 3 and 5 Le Verriers are the first 1, 3 and 5 proposals; the lab's pick among them is the lowest BIC on past data, as live, and only the pick's verdict counts
leverrier.report: correct Neptune verdicts (lens objects) and false ones (SN Ia), against Muse spend, as discoveries per dollar

team_size.skeptics: 1 (physics) against 3 (instrument, physics, memory), from runs a and b: bets dropped, memory flags, and the extra spend
team_size.lookouts: with and without the vote of three, from the live ledger up to the freeze head: how often the vote changed the first lookout's decision, and its extra spend
team_size.director: Spark xhigh alone against review by Wonder max, from runs a and b: log score on reviewed bets with and without the senior's factors, and the spend per review

not_done: F2 (calibration by night) and F5 wait for enough answered live bets; they are reported only if at least 30 answers exist at the freeze head
everything: every number above is reported whatever it says, including the ones that go against SIRA
